statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.description: Losing health every second. You limp and move slower.

statuses.name: Confused
statuses.description: Your feet don't go where you tell them.

statuses.name: Knocked down
statuses.description: Thrown off their feet (heavy blows). Seconds = how long they lie there.

statuses.name: Stealthed
statuses.description: Enemies only notice you up close. Attacking or casting ends it; the first blow hits twice as hard.

statuses.name: Frost Edge
statuses.description: Your weapon is frosted: the next hits deal extra ice damage and chill.

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.description: On fire: losing health every second.

statuses.name: Sprained
statuses.description: Hurt by a fall: limping until it eases.

statuses.name: Well rested
statuses.description: A good night by the fire: you hit a little harder and learn a little faster.

statuses.name: Tired
statuses.description: Too little sleep: you're a bit slower and your blows are weaker.
